timberline-hdz-charcoal.title: Timberline HDZ Charcoal Shingles
timberline-hdz-charcoal.description: Architectural laminate shingles in deep charcoal, with LayerLock technology for a wider nail zone.
about: Timberline HDZ (GAF) is the best selling GAF shingle, a fiberglass asphalt architectural shingle shown here in Charcoal, one of its High Definition colors. LayerLock Technology powers StrikeZone, the largest nailing zone in the industry, and Dura Grip thermal sealant bonds the shingles together once they are exposed to sun and warm temperatures, so they stay in place under high wind.

Each shingle measures approximately 13 1/4 x 39 3/8 in (337 x 1,000 mm) with a 5 5/8 in (143 mm) exposure. A square takes 64 pieces in 3 bundles. GAF matches it with TimberTex or TimberCrest premium ridge cap shingles and with Pro Start, QuickStart or WeatherBlocker starter strips along the eaves and rakes.

Install it on slopes of 2:12 or greater over a deck of at least 3/8 in (10 mm) plywood or OSB. From 2:12 to under 4:12 cover the deck with two layers of GAF Roof Deck Protection; at 4:12 and above one layer is enough. Use zinc coated steel or aluminum roofing nails of 10 to 12 gauge with 3/8 to 7/16 in (10 to 12 mm) heads, long enough to penetrate 3/4 in (19 mm) into the deck, driven flush. The standard pattern is 4 nails about 6 7/8 in (174 mm) from the bottom of the shingle; some codes require 6. Mansard roofs of 21:12 and above are nailed 6 in (152 mm) from the bottom and hand sealed with 4 dabs of shingle tab adhesive.

Standards: UL 2218 Class 3 impact resistance, UL listed to ANSI UL 790 Class A, classified by UL in accordance with ICC ES AC438, ASTM D7158 Class H, ASTM D3161 Class F, ASTM D3018 Type 1 and ASTM D3462, ICC ES Evaluation Reports ESR 1475 and ESR 3267, State of Florida approval, Miami Dade County Product Control approval and Texas Department of Insurance requirements. Some colors are rated by the CRRC and can be used for Title 24 cool roof compliance.

Warranty: Lifetime coverage against manufacturing defects for the original owner of a single family home, or an eligible second owner. The 15 year WindProven Limited Wind Warranty, with no maximum wind speed, applies to LayerLock shingles installed with the required GAF starter strips, roof deck protection and other qualifying GAF accessories. StainGuard Plus adds a 25 year algae protection limited warranty powered by time release algae fighting technology.
highlights: LayerLock technology locks the layers and widens nailing
Rated for winds of one hundred thirty miles
StainGuard granules hold off blue green algae streaks
Class A fire rating, the highest one available

duration-designer-slatestone-grey.title: Duration Designer Slatestone Grey Shingles
duration-designer-slatestone-grey.description: Architectural shingles with a SureNail fabric strip reinforcing the nail zone against high wind.
about: Duration Designer (Owens Corning) is an architectural shingle from the TruDefinition Duration series, shown here in Slatestone Grey. Its patented SureNail Technology is the first and only reinforced nailing zone on the face of a shingle: a tough engineered woven fabric strip embedded in the shingle that overlays both shingle layers, giving Triple Layer Protection against nail pull, and up to 200% wider bond between the layers in the nailing zone than standard shingles. Proprietary Tru Bond weathering grade asphalt sealant holds each course down.

Each shingle has a nominal size of 13 1/4 x 39 3/8 in and a 5 5/8 in exposure. A square takes 64 shingles in 3 bundles and covers 98.4 sq ft. StreakGuard protection blends copper lined granules developed by 3M into the surface to help inhibit blue green algae, and Owens Corning Hip and Ridge shingles are color matched to the Designer colors.

Use galvanized steel, stainless steel or aluminum nails with a minimum 12 gauge shank and 3/8 in head, placed inside the SureNail fastening area and driven at least 3/4 in into the wood deck or through it by 1/4 in, preferably meeting ASTM F1667. The deck can be 6 in boards, 3/8 in plywood or 7/16 in OSB. On slopes of 4:12 and greater use Owens Corning synthetic underlayment or one meeting ASTM D8257; low slopes from 2:12 to under 4:12 need two layers.

Slopes over 60 degrees (21 in per foot) require six nails and four spots of asphalt roofing cement per shingle. Store bundles flat in a covered, ventilated area below 110°F, and handle them with extra care below 40°F. Standards: ASTM D228, ASTM D3018 Type I, ASTM D3161 Class F wind, ASTM D3462, ASTM D7158, ASTM E108 and UL 790 Class A fire, UL 2218 and FM 4473 Class 3 impact, ICC ES AC438, CSA A123.5, Florida Product Approval and Miami Dade Product Approval.

Warranty: Limited Lifetime. Wind coverage reaches up to 160 mph when the Owens Corning component requirements are met and starter shingles are installed on both the eaves and the rakes. The 25 year algae resistance coverage, effective January 1, 2024, requires an approved Owens Corning Hip and Ridge product. The Class 3 impact rating comes from laboratory testing and does not guarantee resistance to all weather; hail damage is specifically excluded from the warranty.

malarkey-smart-start.title: Smart Start Starter Shingles
malarkey-smart-start.description: Perforated NEX polymer modified starter that splits into two strips and seals the first course.
about: Smart Start (Malarkey SKU 210) is a NEX polymer modified starter shingle for steep slope residential roofs. It is manufactured on a non woven fiberglass mat, coated on both sides with NEX polymer modified bitumen compounded with a fire retardant mineral stabilizer, and mineral surfaced. Malarkey requires Smart Start, or an equivalent conforming to ASTM D3462, under all of its shingles, including Windsor, and recommends it on the rake edges too.

Each full size shingle measures 16 3/8 x 38 1/4 in (416 x 972 mm). A perforation in the middle, 8 3/16 in (208 mm) from each edge, splits it lengthwise into two code compliant starter pieces of 8 3/16 x 38 1/4 in (208 x 972 mm), each with its own factory applied seal down strip, for exposures up to 6 3/16 in. A bundle holds 18 full size shingles (36 pieces) and covers 114 ft 9 in (35 m); a pallet carries 21 bundles. Typical granule adhesion is 0.3 g.

Lay the starter with the seal down strip next to the roof edge, overhanging the eave and rake by 1/4 to 3/4 in (6 to 19 mm); on 3 tab and laminate roofs, cut 6 in (152 mm) from the left side of the first piece to offset the end joints. Fasten each starter with four nails set 1 1/2 to 3 in (38 to 76 mm) up from the eave, one 1 in (25 mm) from each end and two evenly spaced between them, never through the seal down strip. Slopes over 21 in per 12 in need six nails. Butt pieces loosely to prevent buckling.

Nails must have a head of at least 3/8 in (10 mm) and be driven flush, not overdriven, underdriven or at an angle; staples are not allowed. Do not use it on slopes under 2:12 (2 in per 12 in). Store it in a cool, dry, well ventilated area and do not double stack pallets. It is tested to ASTM D3462, ASTM D3161 Class F wind resistance and ASTM E108 Class A fire.

Smart Start qualifies for Limited Lifetime Warranty coverage when it is installed with Malarkey shingles and one other Malarkey accessory; the full terms and any extra requirements for specific coverages are in the Malarkey Shingle and Accessory Warranty.
highlights: Perforated to split into two starter strips
Seal down strip holds the first course
Required at the eave under Malarkey shingles
Lifetime coverage with Malarkey shingles and one more accessory

landmark-weathered-wood.title: Landmark Weathered Wood Shingles
landmark-weathered-wood.description: Dual layer laminate cut to a diamond tab, covering thirty three square feet.
about: Landmark (CertainTeed) is a laminated architectural shingle, shown here in Weathered Wood. It is built on a fiberglass mat base with ceramic coated mineral granules embedded in refined, water resistant asphalt; two pieces are laminated together with a tough asphaltic cement, and every shingle carries self sealing adhesive strips and the NailTrak nailing feature. The Algae Resistant (AR) version helps prevent the dark streaks caused by blue green algae (Gloeocapsa magma); AR is not available in every region.

Each shingle measures 13 1/4 x 38 3/4 in with a 5 5/8 in weather exposure. A square takes 65 shingles in 3 bundles, covers approximately 98.4 sq ft and weighs 211 to 225 lb, depending on the manufacturing plant.

Use it on slopes greater than 2 in per foot; low slope applications from 2:12 to under 4:12 need additional underlayment, and where ice can back up at the eaves CertainTeed specifies WinterGuard waterproofing underlayment or an equivalent. Installation instructions are printed on every bundle. Hips and ridges are capped with Shadow Ridge, Cedar Crest or Mountain Ridge in a matching color. No maintenance is required when installed to CertainTeed instructions, but the roof should be inspected at least once a year.

Standards: ASTM D3018 Type I, ASTM D3462, ASTM D3161 Class F and ASTM D7158 Class H wind, ASTM E108 and UL 790 Class A fire, UL 2218 Class 3 impact, ICC Evaluation Service reports ESR 1389 and ESR 3537, CSA A123.5 (regional), Florida Product Approval FL5444, Miami Dade Product Control approval (regional) and Texas Department of Insurance windstorm requirements.

Warranty: lifetime limited and transferable against manufacturing defects, with up to 10 years of SureStart protection; AR shingles add a 25 year algae resistance warranty when installed with the CertainTeed hip and ridge caps above. Standard wind coverage is 110 mph for 15 years, upgradeable to 160 mph with CertainTeed hip and ridge caps plus SwiftStart, SwiftStart SA or High Performance Starter at the eaves and rakes; roof overs are not permitted. In Florida the rake starter can be waived when the shingles are set in a 4 in wide bed of asphalt roofing cement per the building code. Installed as part of an Integrity Roof System, the roof qualifies for unlimited wind velocity coverage.
highlights: Two layers of fiberglass mat build real depth
Covered against winds of one hundred ten miles
Algae resistant granules keep the color clean longer
Lifetime limited warranty with ten year SureStart protection

dynasty-emerald-green.title: Dynasty Emerald Green Shingles
dynasty-emerald-green.description: Laminate shingles with a reinforced ArmourZone nailing band, rated for high wind.
about: Dynasty (IKO) is a heavyweight laminated shingle, shown here in Emerald Green, made on a dimensionally stable non woven glass fiber mat thoroughly impregnated with stabilized waterproofing bitumen. It has a random shake look with high contrast dual band shadow coloring, colored ceramic granules on the top of both layers to protect the asphalt from ultraviolet radiation, release tape and mineral powder on the underside, and algae inhibiting granules for long lasting algae resistance.

Each shingle measures 40 7/8 x 13 3/4 in (1,038 x 349 mm) with a 5 7/8 in (149 mm) exposure and a 2 in (50 mm) headlap. A bundle holds 20 shingles and covers 33.3 sq ft (3.1 m²); a pallet of 40 x 53 in carries 56 bundles. The ArmourZone nailing area is wider for faster installation and is backed by ArmourZone tape on the reverse side for added protection against wind loss, and a thermally activated sealant bonds each course.

Suitable for slopes greater than 4:12, with underlayment strongly recommended below 6:12. It can also be applied on low slopes from 2:12 to 4:12 when the deck is covered with two plies of felt or one ply of IKO Ice and Water Protector. Install it with roofing nails, never staples, exactly as printed on the bundle wrapper, with IKO starter strip shingles at the eaves; rake starters are not required for Dynasty. Cap hips and ridges with an IKO approved hip and ridge shingle such as Marathon Plus AR or IKO UltraHP.

Test results: tear strength passes ASTM D1922 (minimum 1,700 g); stabilized bitumen weight passes ASTM D228 (minimum 41 lb per 100 sq ft, or 2,000 g/m²); granule retention passes ASTM D4977 (minimum 86%); heat resistance passes with no sliding or dripping after 2 hours at 192°F (90°C). It conforms to CSA A123.5, ASTM D3018, ASTM E108 Class A, ASTM D3462, ASTM D3161 Class F and ASTM D7158 Class H and carries a Class 3 impact rating.

Warranty: Limited Lifetime, with non prorated Iron Clad Protection for the first 180 months (15 years) and prorated coverage after that. For the same 15 years it is covered against wind blow off for gusts up to 130 mph, provided it was nailed as the wrapper instructs and has sealed down or been hand sealed; manual sealing is not required in Florida. The algae resistance warranty runs 120 months (10 years).
highlights: ArmourZone band gives a wider stronger nailing area

Rated for winds of one hundred thirty miles
Limited lifetime cover with fifteen year Iron Clad
